map.输入：重量 60kg、4 组、10 次、未填实测 1RM。\n训练总容量=60×:
Input: weight 60 kg, 4 sets, 10 reps, no measured 1RM entered.
Total training volume=60×4×10=2400 kg; total reps=40.
Estimated 1RM=60×(1+10/30)=60×1.333=80 kg.
Intensity percentage=60/80×100=75% → zone hypertrophy (70–80%), 8–12 reps recommended.
Weight ladder: warm-up 80×0.5≈40 kg, ramp 80×0.7≈56 kg, 80×0.8≈64 kg, working set 80×0.9≈72 kg.
Conclusion: this set's intensity is 75% (hypertrophy zone); warm up progressively from 40→56→64→72 kg to the working set.
map.本工具用 w×(1+reps/30)（Epley 简化），适合 reps≤10: This tool uses w×(1+reps/30) (simplified Epley), suitable for reps≤10; the more reps, the larger the error. If you have a measured 1RM, enter it in the leave-blank-to-auto-estimate field and the tool uses it directly for a more accurate intensity. Beyond 10 reps, deriving 1RM is not recommended.

map.70–80% 属肌肥大黄金区间，推荐 8–12 次，主打肌纤维横截面积增长；想冲: 70–80% is the hypertrophy sweet spot, with 8–12 reps recommended, mainly growing muscle-fibre cross-sectional area; to chase strength use ≥85% (1–5 reps), and to train endurance use 50–65% (15+ reps). This tool automatically marks the zone and recommended reps by intensity %.
